title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019
gazette_ref: The Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Sec. 1 - Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (No. 35 of 2019), assented 9 Aug 2019. Text as enacted; later amendments and the Rules made under it are not included. Marginal notes of the gazette are interleaved with the text.
notes: Pecuniary limits in sections 34, 47 and 58 are as enacted. The Central Government can prescribe other values, and the Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction of the District Commission, the State Commission and the National Commission) Rules, 2021 later prescribed different limits - those Rules prevail over the figures in this text.
